question: Is the Remote transcript top progressive effect missing, and is a source-supported host mechanism still omitted?

findings.conclusion: Remote transcript top-only UIKit soft scroll-edge configuration and iOS26 top safe-area underlap are already implemented. Calling the entire Remote top effect unimplemented contradicts current source and retained v483 runtime evidence.

findings.runtime_scope: v483 r3 retained report says content progressively blurred behind status/title/back/options. This batch did not rerun UI or claim current pixel equivalence.

findings.conclusion: Task list uses SwiftUI vertical soft/nil style with V2 selection. Transcript uses UIKit top-only soft style. Model slider separately uses SwiftUIStyleguide.VariableBlur and dynamic private UIKit effect factory. The slider mask/radius is not evidence for a transcript-title blur overlay.

The ordinary Remote collection disables UIKit automatic content inset adjustment. Current reconstructed collection uses UIKit default automatic adjustment. Follow-up closes the official contentPadding and explicit inset producers. Integration must preserve the whole outer geometry/bottom-bars ownership to avoid double-counting SwiftUI safe-area reduction.

next_action.primary: Keep existing top-only soft edge implementation. Parent is independently closing toolbarRole/title behavior first. Integrate explicit collection insets as a separate coherent change with outer safe-area and measured BottomBars inputs.
integration: Measure outer geometry safeAreaInsets at Thread content before BottomBars safe-area modification.
Measure whole BottomBars height across normal composer, approval and user-input branches.
Pass an explicit scoped inset model to collection controller, set contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior=.never and apply the recovered top/bottom formula without duplicate safe-area or bar compensation.
Preserve existing offset/anchor during geometry, keyboard and approval transitions.
Probe viewport/frame/safeAreaInsets/contentInset/adjustedContentInset and top edge style while text scrolls behind title.
next_action.avoid: No arbitrary top overlay, slider blur radius, hardcoded title/status sum or lone automatic-adjustment switch.
next_action.remaining: InitialBottomBarsHeight/additionalTranscriptBottomInset outer embedding defaults and full legacy controller restoration branches remain separate boundaries. These may be explicit adapter inputs, with independent defaults labeled.

cross_platform: Only iOS293 owner chain proved. Android effect and inset ownership need independent evidence. Layout/test contracts are potential shared abstractions; native materials and scroll behavior remain platform-owned.
